Evidence: The Madras High Court ordered the transfer of the murder trial against DMK MP T.R.V.S. Ramesh from the Principal District and Sessions Court in Cuddalore to a court in Chengalpattu. This decision was made by Justice N. Anand Venkatesh based on a plea from G. Senthilvel, the son of the murder victim, who expressed concerns about a fair trial in Cuddalore due to Ramesh's position as a sitting MP. The case involves the suspicious death of an employee at Ramesh's cashew processing unit, with allegations of assault related to theft of cashew nuts (Sources 1 and 2).
Justification: The retrieved evidence directly corroborates the claim that the Madras High Court transferred the murder trial against DMK MP T.R.V.S. Ramesh from Cuddalore to Chengalpattu. Sources 1 and 2 explicitly state that the court made this transfer based on concerns regarding the fairness of the trial in Cuddalore, confirming the core assertion of the claim.
